decisions.statement: A reading that answered is fresh at the moment that reading answered.
A reading that failed is stale and keeps the moment that reading was last fresh.
A stale slot keeps the text that slot last had.
A stale slot says in its tooltip how long that slot has been stale.
A stale slot that was never fresh says so rather than naming a time.
A separator slot is never written to.
The slots are drawn from the slot list rather than from the readings that answered.
An empty tooltip is left unset rather than drawn blank.

definition: what each slot says once a reading has settled or gone stale
